fullPassage: Big mammalian herbivore species react to danger from predators or humans in different ways. Some species are nervous, fast, and programmed for instant flight when they perceive a threat. Other species are slower, less nervous, seek protection in herds, stand their ground when threatened, and don't run until necessary. Naturally, the nervous species are difficult to keep in captivity. If put into an enclosure, they are likely to panic, and either die of shock or hit themselves repeatedly to death against the fence in their attempts to escape. That's true, for example, of gazelles, which for thousands of years were the most frequently hunted game species in some parts of the Fertile Crescent. There is no mammal species that the first settled peoples of that area had more opportunity to domesticate than gazelles. But no gazelle species has ever been domesticated. Just imagine trying to herd an animal that runs away, blindly hits itself against walls, can leap up to nearly 30 feet, and can run at a speed of 50 miles per hour!

det.tip: panic → die of shock / hit themselves to death

ch: 모든 초식동물은 위험을 느끼면 즉시 도망간다.

questions.passage: Big mammalian herbivore species react to danger from predators or humans in different ways. Some species are nervous, fast, and programmed for instant flight when they perceive a threat. Other species are slower, less nervous, seek protection in herds, stand their ground when threatened, and don't run until necessary. Naturally, the nervous species are difficult to keep in captivity. If put into an enclosure, they are likely to panic, and either die of shock or hit themselves repeatedly to death against the fence in their attempts to escape. That's true, for example, of gazelles, which for thousands of years were the most frequently hunted game species in some parts of the Fertile Crescent. There is no mammal species that the first settled peoples of that area had more opportunity to domesticate than gazelles. But no gazelle species has ever been domesticated. Just imagine trying to herd an animal that runs away, blindly hits itself against walls, can leap up to nearly 30 feet, and can run at a speed of 50 miles per hour!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 가젤은 느리고 차분한 종이 아니라, 빠르게 도망가고 공황에 빠져 벽에 부딪히는 예민한 종의 예시
det.analysis:
✅ ① 가젤이 느리고 차분: 본문 S9에서 가젤은 도망가고 벽에 부딪히며 시속 50마일로 달리는 예민한 종의 예시 — 불일치 ←정답
❌ ② 예민한 종 즉각 도주 프로그램화: 본문 S2 'programmed for instant flight when they perceive a threat'와 일치
❌ ③ 위협받아도 자리 지킴: 본문 S3 'stand their ground when threatened, and don't run until necessary'와 일치
❌ ④ 시속 50마일, 30피트 점프: 본문 S9 'can leap up to nearly 30 feet, and can run at a speed of 50 miles per hour'와 일치
det.tip: 가젤 = 느린 종이 아니라 빠르게 도망가는 예민한 종의 대표 예시

ch: 가젤은 느리고 차분하여 무리를 지어 천천히 이동하는 동물이다.
예민한 종은 위협을 감지하면 즉각적으로 도망치도록 프로그램화되어 있다.
어떤 종들은 위협을 받아도 필요할 때까지 도망가지 않고 자리를 지킨다.
가젤은 시속 50마일로 달리고 거의 30피트를 뛰어오를 수 있다.

det.korean: ② attack(공격) → flight(도주): 예민한 종은 위협을 감지하면 '도주'하도록 프로그램화되어 있으며, 공격이 아님
det.analysis:

❌ ③ 원문 일치: 차분한 종은 무리에서 보호를 찾고 자리를 지킨다는 내용
❌ ④ 원문 일치: 예민한 종은 갇힌 상태를 유지하기 어렵다는 내용
det.tip: flight(도주) ≠ attack(공격). 예민한 종의 특성은 즉각적인 '도주'
